name: Roc Marciano
sources: strettoblaster — post-Marcberg minimalism and the drumless revolution (https://strettoblaster.com/pieces/post-marcberg-minimalism-drumless/)
notes: The origin point of drumless rap, and every parameter here is a subtraction. The research says percussion is "dissolved, muscle under linen" and that where drums appear it is "a soft kick on 1 and a buried snare on 2&4" — so `kick.densityPerBar` is 1–2 with `syncopation` 0.12, the sparsest kick in the batch, and `velocityTiers` tops out at 96 where the archetype reaches 127. The melody is a single sustained phrase "repeated without variation": 1–3 notes a bar, `contour.riff` 0.68, `octaveJumpProb` 0.03, register 55–78 for the very low, un-EQ'd sources. ⚠ `hihat.continuous` is false and `fillDensity` sits at 0.28 — the floor. A model that declares a hat block owes every seed a hat, so "frequently no hats" is authored as the emptiest legal stream rather than as an absent one; a truly hatless record is not expressible here and that is an engine limit, not a reading. ⚠ `chords.impliedByRiff` is set, and it describes the record: "1–2 bar loops, static i… harmonic content often a single sustained chord". The variety the chord part still owes a producer comes from `chordDurationBeats` 2–32, three harmonic rhythms and a voicing register spanning nearly four octaves — not from progressions he does not play. ⛔ The `i–VII` and `i–iv` families at weights 2 and 1 are **INFERRED**. The research names only static `i`. They are the first two things to delete if this model ever moves more than the records do. ⚠ `confidence` is medium: the research rates the idiom medium-high through dedicated analysis, but the analysis is of a scene, not a session. ⚠ **The bass pool was widened after `bass.rs` measured it at 0.725 distinct against a floor of 0.95.** It was authored passingTones ["P5"], followRootsProb 0.94, anticipationProb 0.12 over register [21,39] — a faithful description of a sample-loop bass, and one that leaves a seed nothing to vary but root and octave. Now ["P5","m7"], root lock 0.86, anticipation 0.24, register [21,43]. The line is still overwhelmingly root-on-kick; what changed is how many different records it can be, not how busy any one of them is. ⚠ The chord voicing moved up to [44, 86] so the bass stays under the harmony — it started at 36 against a bass reaching 43, an overlap of 8. The span is preserved; a voicing that low was competing with the bass rather than sitting over it. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 761 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: styles 3, densityRatio 0.5, melody density [1,5]. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [1,2], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
